questions.stem: This H&E section shows thin-walled, air-filled spaces opening off a larger conducting channel (RB), with clusters of terminal sacs (AS) and their ducts (AD). What structure of the respiratory system is shown?

choices.label: B
choices.text: Pulmonary alveoli (respiratory zone of the lung)

explanation.summary: The labels mark the respiratory bronchiole (RB), alveolar ducts (AD), alveolar sacs (AS), and alveoli (A) - the gas-exchanging respiratory zone of the lung. The thin alveolar walls with delicate capillary networks are characteristic pulmonary parenchyma.
